en: Black‑and‑white view of a dramatic rock cliff dominating the scene, with a small path leading toward a narrow cleft in the rock. In the foreground there is a landscaped park with young trees and flower beds, and on the right side stands a wooden house with a steep roof and a tall flagpole. The image has a white printed caption at the bottom left reading "FJÄLLBACKA." and a small publisher's logo with the number 354 in the bottom right.
